test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A group of 10 women can weave a designer saree in 20 days. After 4 days, another group of 20 women joins them to work on the same saree. In how many more days will the saree be completely woven?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Work left for 10 women = 20 − 4 = 16 days.

Total units to complete = 10 women × 16 days = 160 units.

New strength = 10 + 20 = 30 women.

Extra days required = 160 units ÷ 30 women = 16/3 days.

**∴ Answer = 5 1/3 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial number of women (M1) = 10

Initial time to weave (D1) = 20 days

Time elapsed = 4 days

New women joining = 20

**Formula used:**

Total Work = M × D (Work remains constant or additive)

 Work done in 4 days Remaining Work 10 Women 30 Women (10 + 20) 
• Work = 40 units Work = 160 units Total Work = 200 units 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total work to be done = 10 women × 20 days = 200 units.

⇒ Work completed in 4 days = 10 women × 4 days = 40 units.

⇒ Remaining work = 200 − 40 = 160 units.

⇒ New total number of women = 10 + 20 = 30 women.

⇒ More days required to finish work = Remaining work ÷ New total women.

⇒ Days = 160 ÷ 30 = 16/3 = 5 1/3 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 1/3 days (Option 2).**
